 MISSOULA, Mont. — The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission announced two recalls Thursday, Nov. 19, involving infant bouncers that can collapse and adult bed rails linked to a reported death.
 Kidsview infant bouncers 
 Kidsview is recalling about 412 infant bouncers because they can collapse during use, posing an injury risk to babies.
 The company has received seven reports of collapses, including two incidents in which an infant's head struck the surface below. One consumer reported seeking medical attention.
 The recall involves khaki-colored bouncers with an accessory bar and hanging animal toys. The products were sold on Amazon from August 2022 through November 2023 for $60 to $170.
 Consumers should check for date codes 2022/08, 2022/09 or 2022/10 on the label sewn behind the fabric seat.
 Owners should immediately stop using the bouncers and contact Kidsview at haimaoziying@163.com to receive an Amazon gift card. Consumers will be asked to mark the seat "RECALLED" and submit a photo showing the date-code label.
 Full recall information 
 Xentrawave adult portable bed rails
 Xentrawave is recalling about 2,114 adult portable bed rails after a reported death involving entrapment.
 According to the CPSC, an 89-year-old woman died in 2026 after becoming trapped between a bed rail and a mattress.
 The recalled rails can trap users within the rail or between the rail and mattress, creating a risk of suffocation. One model also poses stability, strap and laceration hazards.
 The recall involves models XT016 and XT026. The XT016 rails were sold on Amazon from May 2025 through March 2026. The XT026 rails with batch number 20251212 were sold from March through August 2026. Prices ranged from $37 to $40.
 Consumers should immediately stop using the rails and contact Xentrawave for a full refund.
 To receive a refund, consumers will be instructed to cut the foam on the rail's handle grips and submit a photo of the destroyed product to xentrawavedirect@163.com or through the recall webpage.
